title: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. received a NYSE American delisting notice on April 17, 2026, for failure to timely file its Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025. The company has a six-month cure period expiring October 17, 2026, and expects to file by April 30, 2026. Trading continues with .LF designation while a trading halt from April 2, 2026, remains in effect.
